learning_outcomes.text: Control exposure using the aperture, shutter speed and ISO triangle
Choose focal length and aperture to shape depth of field and perspective
Compose photographs using framing, balance and point of view
Use natural and artificial light directionally and for quality
Manage focus, white balance and basic camera settings deliberately
Apply a non-destructive editing workflow to finish an image

integrative_case: A learner shoots a small portrait set in available light: setting exposure manually for a chosen depth of field, positioning the subject to the light, bracketing a few frames, and finishing selects with a non-destructive edit.
